node.name: class_booking_info_reply
node.description: Classify what kind of information the customer's reply supplies after the studio assistant asked for a detail.

conditions.a: The customer gives a preferred date or session time for the class.
conditions.b: The customer provides their booking reference or membership number as requested.
conditions.c: The customer says they do not know or cannot find the requested information.
conditions.d: The customer declines to share the requested information and refuses to answer.

ctx: I want to move my weaving class to a different week.
Sure, could you give me the booking reference from your confirmation email?
examples.msg: Oh, I don't remember getting an email with any number in it. My daughter did the booking for me on her phone.

ctx: Welcome to the studio! Before we continue, may I have your home address for our mailing list?
examples.msg: I prefer not giving my address, is not necessary for me to receive the letters from you.

ctx: hey, can I check what time my woodworking class starts?
Of course. What's your booking reference?
examples.msg: Sure, it's WK-48213.

ctx: I want to sign up for the woodworking course.
Great! Which start date would you like, 5 May or 19 May?
examples.msg: Seriously, nobody on your site can tell me if tools are included or if I have to buy my own? That's what I actually need to know.
examples.why: asks about included tools; no answer type fits

ctx: Hi! Which date would you like for the beginner pottery class: 3 March or 10 March?
examples.msg: The second one, please.

node.name: costume_issue_triage

conditions.a: The renter reports that a costume arrived torn, stained or otherwise damaged.
conditions.b: The renter reports that ordered costumes have not been delivered on time.
conditions.c: The renter reports that a costume does not fit the performer it was meant for.

ctx: Sorry to hear that. What's going on with the costumes?
examples.msg: pirate coat. lead actor swimming in it. sleeves past fingertips
examples.why: coat far too big for actor

examples.msg: Good afternoon, I do hope you are well. I've been rehearsing lines with my nephew all week and we got into a little debate, so I wondered whether you might know roughly how long the drive is from the coast up to the mountains? We're planning a trip afterwards. Many thanks!
I would like to know whether you offer discounted rates for school productions that rent more than twenty costumes.
examples.why: pricing question, not a reported problem

ctx: Hi, this is the costume house support line. What's happened?

ctx: You mentioned the Victorian gown. When you unpacked it, were there any marks or tears on the fabric?

examples.why: confirms marks and tears on gown

ctx: Costume house, how may we help?

node.name: parts_order_confirmation
node.description: Decide how the buyer responds to the summarised parts order the assistant asked them to confirm.

conditions.a: The buyer wants to change quantities or part numbers in the summarised order.
conditions.b: The buyer wants to change the delivery address or date of the order.
conditions.c: The buyer confirms the summarised order as presented and wants it placed.
conditions.d: The buyer wants to cancel the order and not proceed with the purchase.

Here's your order: 40 x VA-220 valve assemblies, delivered to Dock 3 at the Harlow site on 14 June. Shall I place it?
examples.msg: Almost right, but the delivery site is wrong: please ship them to our Brunswick facility instead of Harlow. The quantities and part numbers are all fine as they are.
examples.why: changes delivery site only; quantities and parts unchanged

ctx: To confirm: 12 heat shield tiles, part HT-09, delivered on 2 May to your workshop. Is that correct?
examples.msg: Actually we need twenty of those tiles, not twelve, the project got bigger.

Summary: 200 x FC-15 couplings, lead time 30 days, total 18,400. Confirm?
examples.msg: no. scrap it. project dead

Got it: 6 IG-4 igniter kits with material certificates, delivered to Bay 7 on 9 August. Shall I go ahead?

node.name: driver_support_handoff

Let's try a reset. Please unplug, wait 30 seconds and tap your card again.
examples.msg: Did that like five freaking times already. I'm stuck here at 4 percent and this script ain't cutting it, man.

ctx: Hi, I'm the charging assistant. I can help you here, or connect you to a person. What would you like?
examples.msg: bot fine. connector stuck in car after session tho
Hey, so I've been through this chat thing twice already and it just keeps sending me the same help article about double charges.

ctx: Hello! Want me to help you troubleshoot, or would you prefer to wait for an agent? Current wait is about 25 minutes.
examples.msg: Nah, I'll stick with you, no way I'm waiting that long. Cool that you added the site by the train station, by the way. So why does the screen say cable locked?

node.name: battery_ticket_severity
node.description: Assign a severity level to a support request from a battery system owner.

conditions.a: Safety emergency: the battery shows smoke, fire, swelling, hissing, a burning or chemical smell or unusual heat; the owner needs immediate safety instructions.
conditions.b: Urgent fault without danger: the system has stopped supplying power, the inverter is offline or shows an error code, but there is no smoke, heat or smell.
conditions.c: Routine request: questions about gradually reduced capacity, app or display oddities, or booking a regular maintenance check while the system still works normally.

examples.msg: There's a burning plastic smell coming from the battery cabinet in the garage and it feels hot to the touch. Also, my last invoice has the wrong address on it.
examples.why: burning smell and heat; invoice secondary

ctx: hey, got a question about my home battery
Sure, what's going on with it?
examples.msg: So the side of the battery pack is kind of bulging out now and there's a faint hissing noise coming from it.
examples.why: swelling and hissing is a safety emergency

examples.msg: Since this morning the big battery box on my wall isn't giving the house any power at all, and the little screen shows a red code E-41.
examples.why: no power, error code, no danger

examples.msg: When we installed it two years ago it ran the house through the whole evening, now it's empty by about 8 pm.

ctx: Battery support desk. What can we help with today?
examples.msg: It's been almost three years since anyone looked at the unit, and the warranty booklet says something about yearly checks.

Hello there, so sorry to bother you on a Sunday. My husband and I had our grid battery put in last spring and we've been ever so pleased with it, but just now I noticed a thin wisp of smoke from the vent at the side and a sharp chemical smell in the utility room. What should we do? Thank you kindly.

conditions.b: A client asks for a progress update on their ongoing design project.
conditions.c: A client wants to book or reschedule a meeting with their architect.

node.name: food_bank_router
node.description: Decide what the person contacting the food bank wants to do.

conditions.a: A recipient wants to book a new food parcel collection slot at a distribution site, for example choosing a day and time to pick up.
conditions.b: Someone wants to donate food or household goods, including asking which items are accepted and where or when to drop them off.
conditions.c: Someone wants to sign up for or swap a volunteer shift, such as sorting in the warehouse or helping at a distribution day.
conditions.d: Someone asks whether they are eligible for support and which documents or referrals are needed to register as a recipient.
conditions.e: A recipient wants to cancel or move a food parcel collection slot they have already booked, not book a new one.
conditions.f: Someone needs food urgently today, for example has nothing to eat tonight, and asks for emergency same-day help outside normal bookings.

examples.msg: hey, I'm already registered but haven't booked anything this month yet, can I get a slot to pick up a parcel Thursday?
So the fridge is literally empty, payday's not till next week and the kids need dinner tonight.
hi, could I grab a pickup time for a parcel at the church hall site, sometime Saturday morning?
I've cleared out my cupboards and have a box of tins and pasta, where can I bring it?
I think I have a, what do you call it, appointment? for collecting food on Tuesday, but I can't make it then, can it be another day? Also is the hall the one next to the school?
examples.why: move existing collection; location question secondary

node.name: print_order_detail_reply
node.description: Classify what kind of information the customer's reply supplies after the print shop assistant asked for an order detail.

conditions.a: The customer supplies a quantity: a number of copies or units to print, for example 500 flyers or a couple of hundred posters.
conditions.b: The customer supplies a paper size or format, such as A4, A3, poster size, or picks one of the formats offered in the question.
conditions.c: The customer supplies a deadline or collection date, for instance by Friday or next Monday morning, including requested delivery dates.
conditions.d: The customer says they do not know or have not decided yet, and asks for advice or a recommendation before answering.
conditions.e: The customer refuses or declines to give the requested information, for example does not want to share contact details or a budget.

ctx: Hello, I'd like some posters for our choir concert.
Lovely! How many posters would you like?
examples.msg: Oh, before that, do forgive me, my granddaughter asked me this morning and I simply couldn't answer: do you happen to know why the sky turns orange at sunset? It's been bothering me all day, silly as it sounds.

ctx: I need flyers for a bake sale.
Sure. Would you like them in A5 or A6?
examples.msg: The bigger one, please.

ctx: Great. How many copies do you need?
examples.msg: one per house. street has about 240

ctx: I want to print my thesis with hard cover.
Of course. When do you need the bound copies ready?
examples.msg: I must give it to university in next Wednesday, so before this day please.

ctx: Thanks for your order of business cards. Which paper weight would you prefer: 300gsm or 400gsm?
examples.msg: Oh goodness, I've run my little bakery for years and never once had cards made, so those numbers mean nothing to me. Which would feel sturdier in the hand and not bend in a wallet? I'd love your thoughts.
